provenance.l: Beagle 2 ESA/UK Commission of Inquiry report (5 April 2004) §3: entry at 5.5 km/s; Mach 1 in under 3 min, pilot chute; front shield and back cover released, main chute; altimeter; air-bags inflated at 200 m; rebounds up to 28 m (risk of bouncing into the main parachute). Entry angle, chute size and the shield/cover mass split are not given — estimated
NASA — Beagle 2 in depth: 69 kg at launch, 33.2 kg lander at touchdown; landed 25 Dec 2003, found partly deployed by MRO in 2015
